clauses.quote: This Lease shall automatically renew for an additional twelve (12) month term unless either party delivers written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term.
clauses.explanation: If you don't tell the landlord in writing two months before your lease ends, you're locked into another full year.
clauses.question_to_ask: Can the renewal be changed to month-to-month, or the notice period shortened to 30 days?

clauses.explanation: The lease doesn't say whether you can sublet. That matters if you'll be gone for the summer or a semester abroad.
clauses.question_to_ask: If I'm away for the summer, can I sublet, and what's the approval process?
